title: DelegationToken
description: A signed assertion by a granting principal that a receiving principal MAY exercise specified capabilities under specified constraints during a specified time window. See spec §8.1, §11.

aud.description: Audience binding — MUST equal sub for direct delegations

exp.description: Expiration. RECOMMENDED TTL ≤ 600 seconds. See spec §17.

capabilities.description: One or more capabilities being delegated, each with its own constraints

sub_delegation_depth_remaining.description: Decrements at each sub-delegation. Bounds maximum chain length. See spec §11.

parent_delegation_id.description: OPTIONAL. References the parent delegation in the chain (omitted for root delegations).

signature.description: Signature over the JCS-canonicalized form of this object with the signature field omitted. See spec §6.3.
